name: What is the process for getting walker-friendly home modifications done?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting walker-friendly home modifications done?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation where a contractor assesses your home and discusses your specific needs and goals. Following this, a detailed proposal and estimate will be provided, outlining the scope of work, materials, and costs. Once approved, necessary permits are secured, and a project timeline is established. Construction then proceeds, with regular communication to keep you informed. Upon completion, a final walkthrough ensures all modifications meet your expectations and comply with safety standards. City Dweller, LLC manages all stages from design to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, a detailed proposal, securing permits, construction, and a final walkthrough to ensure satisfaction and safety.
